title: Dissect Latest .pcap (tshark)
description: Pulls the newest .pcap/.pcapng capture from Flipper SD and dissects protocol hierarchy via Kali tshark.
command: import os, pathlib; from z2z.captures import parse_pcap_capture; raw = pathlib.Path('latest.pcap').read_bytes(); rep = parse_pcap_capture(raw); src = os.path.basename(os.environ.get('Z2Z_PULLED_REMOTE', 'latest.pcap')); txt = f'File: {src}\n' + str(rep['compact_text']); pathlib.Path('pcap_summary.txt').write_text(txt + '\n'); print(txt)
